warning: Red: the refuges and closed strips named in the Iowa 2026-27 regulations (p. 19 and p. 23): wildlife refuges (closed to all hunting) and waterfowl refuges / closed areas (closed to ducks, geese and coots). All outlines are the whole DNR or federal area, because the posted refuge is only a part of it: follow the signs. Not drawn: the Canada-goose-closed areas in 12 counties and the three metro goose zones (DNR maps only), and the blind and decoy rules on Mississippi River pools 14-18. Always check the current regulations.
source: Iowa DNR 2026-27 Hunting, Trapping & Migratory Game Bird Regulations (Iowa Refuges, p. 19; Areas Closed to Waterfowl Hunting, p. 23); Iowa DNR Public Areas layer (outlines); USFWS National Hunt Units; USGS NHD.
